Title key art for a mystery adventure video game, wide cinematic 16:9 composition.
Use the attached reference image ONLY as the character model sheet for the rabbit (same
design, same colours, same details); do not copy its layout.

On the RIGHT third: the rabbit character standing on its small wooden specimen crate,
full body, three-quarter view, gesturing theatrically with its long slim silver probe toward

Character design (IDENTICAL in every drawing): a child-height taxidermied WHITE RABBIT specimen standing upright on its hind legs like a small person; clean white fur with a slightly stiff, preserved look; visible dark thread cross-stitch seams around the neck and along one long ear; its LEFT eye is a glossy red glass bead (#FF2E63), its RIGHT eye is a black sewn-on button with visible thread; long upright ears; an oversized white lab coat with rolled-up sleeves whose hem hangs past its knees; a formalin-green (#C6FF3D) bow tie at the collar; a small blank paper specimen tag pinned to one ear with a thin insect pin (the tag is completely blank, no writing); it stands on a small wooden specimen crate. Elegant, theatrical, creepy-cute, charming, not scary, not bloody.

stained-glass shards, the fragments slightly separated with thin dark gaps between them,
glowing luminous cyan (#3DE0FF) from within, some shards drifting away, faceless and serene,
beautiful rather than frightening.

floor, a hard theatrical spotlight on the rabbit. The UPPER-LEFT third of the image is kept

Polished key-visual quality for a premium mystery adventure video game.
Strict constraints: NO gore, NO blood, NO wounds, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO numerals, NO writing of any kind, NO captions, NO speech bubbles, NO logos, NO watermark, NO signature, NO frame, NO border.
